task: T-44 launch profiling + safe launch-cost optimisations
method: 5 interleaved fresh-process rounds, A/B alternating start order per round (rounds 1/3/5: base then opt; rounds 2/4: opt then base). Each round is a separate `acos launch --json` process; wall is host clock around process start/exit, RSS is the launch report's peak_rss_bytes (VmHWM). ACOS_PROFILE unset for both.

before.label: pristine HEAD 791f14d release build (no profiling changes)

after.label: W109-A release build (profiling hooks + font-buffer copy elimination)

note: The launch is dominated by framework class initialisation during bindApplication, not by class parsing. The only safe optimisation landed in this wave removes a per-font copy of the whole font file in Font$Builder.nBuild; the copy was pure waste (nBuild stores the direct-buffer address, never the bytes), which is why peak RSS drops ~18 MiB. Wall time is within host noise (~1.5%). See results/perf/LAUNCH_PROFILE.md for the phase/counter breakdown and the ranked opportunity list.
